name: CHAOS;CHILD
overview: Chaos;Child is a 2014 visual novel developed by Mages that serves as the fourth main entry in the Science Adventure series and a thematic sequel to Chaos;Head.  Set in 2015, six years after a devastating earthquake and the "New Generation Madness" serial killings in Shibuya, the story follows Takuru Miyashiro, a high school student and newspaper club president who investigates a new series of murders mimicking the original cases.
